Includes the 143 / 12 / 30 significant counts, PROGENy TGFb 59.359794, and the printed leading-edge genes.

replay.chain: filter_by_expr -> normalize_total/log1p/scale/pca/swap_layer -> rankby_obsm -> PyDESeq2 (design '~condition', refit_cooks=True, contrast condition treatment vs control) -> stat matrix -> ulm x3 -> leading_edge x3; same calls and parameters as the notebook, no network
replay.outcome: All 4 replays (two identical n_cpus=8 runs, n_cpus=1, and DE on the filtered AnnData without the PCA cells) reproduce every reference output bitwise: kept genes (ordered), rank_obsm, PCA variance ratio and signed X_pca, all 6 DESeq2 columns, the stat matrix, ulm scores and padj for all three networks, significant sets, and the three leading-edge lists (ordered). Max abs/rel difference 0.0 everywhere.
replay.pydeseq2_deterministic: Yes in this environment: bitwise identical between the notebook kernel and 4 fresh processes, and independent of n_cpus (1 vs 8) and of whether PCA/rankby_obsm ran on the same AnnData first.

recommended_test_tolerances.identifiers: exact (ordered gene lists, source names, significant sets, leading-edge order)

deseq2_baseMean.why: size factors and normalised means are closed-form

deseq2_log2FoldChange_lfcSE_stat.why: PyDESeq2 fits dispersions/LFCs with iterative optimisers; a different BLAS/thread layout or platform can move results near optimiser tolerance. Observed difference here is 0.

deseq2_pvalue_padj.why: follow stat; atol for underflowed/near-zero values

ulm_scores.why: smooth function of the DE stat; expect exact identity when the saved DE table is the input

ulm_padj.why: PROGENy TGFb, MAPK and PI3K padj are exactly 0.0 (underflow), so rtol alone cannot be used

recommended_test_tolerances.X_pca: compare |X_pca| (sign-invariant), atol 1e-4; signs were identical here but are solver-dependent

flakiness_and_test_risks: Network: GEO, Zenodo and OmniPath (omnipathdb.org plus static.omnipathdb.org) are live downloads and the networks drift. Tests should load data/networks/*.parquet and data/hsctgfb_as_returned.h5ad, not re-download.

adjustText label layout in dc.pl.volcano and dc.pl.source_targets is not reproducible between processes, even with the same PYTHONHASHSEED. Likely cause from source reading: adjustText's default 1 s wall-clock limit, which decoupler does not override. Do not pixel-compare these figures; compare the data and label texts instead.
PyDESeq2 wall time varies widely with load and n_cpus: 28.9 s in the notebook, 27.8 to 79.4 s at n_cpus=8 in replays, 125 s at n_cpus=1. Use generous timeouts. Results did not change.

DeseqDataSet(adata=...) shares and mutates the input AnnData.uns. It adds _squared_logres, disp_function_type, prior_disp_var and trend_coeffs (a pandas Series); X is unchanged. After that, AnnData.write_h5ad on the input fails with IORegistryError on uns/trend_coeffs. This is why the capture hook could not save the cell-23 state. Wrappers should pass adata.copy().

pandas 3: AnnData built from a DataFrame has read-only X (stage-1 note). That does not apply here because hsctgfb casts to float and h5ad loads are writeable. read_csv is round-trip precise by default; under pandas<3 pass float_precision='round_trip'.
Float32 values: X_pca and the rank_obsm stat/pval/padj come from float32 PCA. Compare them in float32 or with the looser tolerances above.
dc.pl.leading_edge orders genes with np.argsort(-stat), which is not a stable sort. Tied stats could reorder across numpy versions. Exact ordered lists matched here.

Numba JIT: first calls compile, and cache=True writes .nbi/.nbc files into site-packages/decoupler/mt/__pycache__. This stage added one, _gsea._esrank-37.py313.nbi. Run tests serially or give first calls time to compile.
Cell 2 prints a TqdmWarning (ipywidgets not installed). It is cosmetic; text comparisons should ignore it.
limitations: The network snapshots are the DataFrames the decoupler 2.3.1 loaders returned inside the kernel, after loader post-processing. They are not the raw HTTP payloads. The raw GEO .tsv.gz sha256 was not recorded; the AnnData h5ad sha256 and a content hash are.
Download time is taken from papermill's start and end times for the loader cells, plus the hook capture timestamps. It includes post-processing and capture time.

Capture used an IPython startup file under a scratch IPYTHONDIR, so the kernel ran with a fresh IPython profile. No user ipython_config.py exists, so behaviour is otherwise unchanged. The hook prints nothing and adds no names to the user namespace, and no notebook cell was modified. Its cost was about 7 s of wall time.
The capture of adata after cell 23 failed (see DeseqDataSet side effect). It is not needed for any reference, and the replay records the mutation directly.
Tolerances are recommendations. Every observed difference is exactly 0, so cross-platform and BLAS variation was not measured.
Figures of cells 38 and 48 are not pixel-reproducible (see flakiness).
